changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.38[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]A new Settings window[/COLOR]
-New: luc_kodi's own Settings window, the same in every skin: sections on the left, settings on the right under their headings, on/off switches, every current value at a glance and lists that open on the value you have. Settings appear, hide and unlock at once as you change the ones they depend on.
-New: each service and block starts with its own green heading, so you can see where Trakt, SIMKL, Premiumize.me or TorBox begin and end. Parts of a block are in amber and explanations in grey.
-New: "Search settings" at the top of the sections opens the plugin's search; a setting found there opens in the window, already selected.
-The window opens from everywhere, Kodi's own Settings included: Settings in the add-on's context menu and its Configure button open it straight away. Other add-ons keep Kodi's dialog.
-Kodi's Settings dialog for luc_kodi now holds a single "Open luc_kodi Settings..." button, used only if the window cannot open.
[COLOR fffdb515]Settings for future Kodi versions[/COLOR]
-The settings now use Kodi's current settings format (Kodi 18 and later), the one future Kodi versions keep. Every setting keeps its name, its default and the value you chose: nothing has to be set again.
-A setting that shows or hides with another one now names it instead of counting positions in the list, so adding a setting can no longer unhook its neighbours.
-Fixed: "Select streaming platforms...", "Select TV networks..." and "Renew each one every (days)" stayed visible with the TMDB catalog update switched off.
[COLOR fffdb515]Tracking accounts[/COLOR]
-New: what you watched on MDBList shows as watched in every list: movies, shows, seasons and episodes. It is on when Trakt is not your source of watched marks (Settings > Tracking Accounts > MDBList > Use MDBList as watched indicators source).
-New: MDBList: In Progress (TV), the next episode of every show you are watching on MDBList, latest watched first. It is in TV Shows and in its MDBList folder, and can be hidden in Settings > Navigation.
-New: marking something watched or unwatched in luc_kodi also marks it on your SIMKL or MDBList account when that account gives the watched marks. A show or a season goes in one request.
-The watched history of SIMKL and MDBList is checked in the background every 10 minutes with one small request, and read in full only when something changed.
-Fixed: with SIMKL as the source of watched marks only movies showed as watched; shows, seasons and episodes now do too.
-Fixed: MDBList lists and history longer than one page now load whole.
-MDBList: if MDBList stops accepting your connection, luc_kodi tells you once and where to authorize again, instead of showing empty lists.
-Trakt: before connecting, luc_kodi tells you that a free Trakt account keeps one connected app at a time, so connecting luc_kodi disconnects the one you had.
